acceptance.claim: A valid plan compiles into a deterministic hash-bound resumable bundle and invalid coverage or unresolved decisions fail closed.

Ordinary conversation starts, resumes, reviews, audits, and repairs a plan without host-specific syntax; conversation, optional command, CLI/API, and native-host inputs compile to semantically equivalent WorkRequests, while absence of /goal never fails readiness or parity.
Worker recipes enforce ownership, intent receipts, checkpoints, amendments, selective regeneration, and two-attempt repair.
Reconciliation re-derives plan, implementation, proof, provider, and runtime state and repairs only safe drift.
All seven registered adapters pass fixtures and an unknown host returns UNSUPPORTED.
Live detection distinguishes installed hosts from stale config and produces full selected-set parity receipts.
External source locks reject mutable, hash-mismatched, unlicensed, unsafe, or non-rollbackable installation candidates.
Selected skills are complete on every installed host; rejected/link-only sources are not materialized or globally loaded.
Every named provider has a provider-neutral adapter, bounded lifecycle, health proof, and claim-specific activation.
Verification selects the cheapest evidence that proves the claim and uses real UI/device flows for applicable business behavior.
Local browser, mobile, and Pencil sessions are foreground-observable; CI headless mode is explicit and receipted.
Pencil discovery follows live stable sources and never persists /tmp/.mount paths; missing installation follows the official fallback contract.
Routing is derived from facts, impact, claim class, availability, and risk rather than prompt keywords alone.
Rule, skill, provider, host, and plan concepts each have one canonical owner with no stale conflicting mirror.
Required hosted CI terminates within bounded waits and unavailable self-hosted certification cannot queue a required check forever.
The phase uses its own compiled recipes, reconcile loop, provider routing, and evidence ledger before final verification.
Plan compaction reduces active artifacts while preserving original intent, decisions, locks, traceability, and PASS evidence.
Closeout is bound to an exact owner-approved receipt and leaves final main CI green, installed-host parity complete, and only approved branches deleted.

Every closed-loop decision is traceable through typed feedforward and feedback sensors with source, freshness, independence, confidence, runtime clamps, failure-to-eval conversion, and workaround retirement evidence.

The high-impact workflow graph has no unresolved semantic contradiction across lifecycle, context sizing, delegation, routing, research, browser QA, quality, and UI precedence, while all catalog fixtures still pass.

Control Plane activation is denied before complete skill/provider/tool/MCP/rule/command/host/runtime parity, terminal harness evidence, green exact-SHA CI, installed-host receipts, and owner-approved closeout; after those proofs it is emitted as the sole final successor phase.

A normal-prompt post-plan finding is durably classified and bound, selectively reopens only impacted claims in a new candidate epoch, retains but stales affected historical evidence, emits a bounded repair packet, and derives a new terminal result from fresh proof without rewriting prior PASS history.
